about: What a street of each kind spawns: buildings a hectare (density) and the share of each use (docs/v2/borrow-and-spawn.md §2.1, §5, §6). A street's building slots are the buildings on its ground: its form's lots (landscape.ts formOf: its frontage, the rows behind it to its edge, a square's rings) and the city's lots there. A street laid out as a form of its own (a shopping street, an alley, a residential street, a waterfront) has the density its form builds on its own ground, measured 2026-11-01 (40 streets of each kind at the spawn's sizes); in a city the roads crossing it take some of its rows. A street that is the ground's own, or holds the city's lots round its compound (an avenue, a commercial centre, a station front, a square, a park), has the density measured on vol 1's city (2026-11-01). The shares are the uses its buildings draw (LANDSCAPES' uses). takes (the user, 2026-11-01): a street that is the ground's own, not an area laid out apart: an avenue takes a road of the city at least `road` m wide, a crossing the meeting of two roads each at least `crossing` m wide; it builds no form of its own, and its buildings are the city's lots already round it (its heights and uses on them). A crossing's density is a first guess until one is built.
